The strongest fresh weak-signal clusters are NBIS financing-plus-capacity expansion, BTDR's shift toward contracted AI/HPC infrastructure, IONQ's vertically integrated foundry/product transition, and ALAB/CRDO connectivity expansion. Machine gating probes are healthy, but the lane does not claim discoveryScanCompleted because cadence-due intelligent/manual families and FINRA row-level event acquisition were not fully completed in this pass.

materialFindings.finding: AI-infrastructure demand is converting into both long-duration customer commitments and asset-backed financing capacity: Nebius disclosed a five-year Meta capacity agreement and a $775M secured GPU-backed facility. This is a positive scale signal but simultaneously raises project-finance and concentration dependencies.

Bitdeer is materially migrating from mining-only exposure toward AI/HPC infrastructure: a 121 IT MW Norway lease was announced with roughly $4.7B base-term contracted revenue and a new Texas land purchase was framed explicitly for AI/HPC development. Delivery, tenant-credit backstop and financing remain execution dependencies.

IonQ's July SkyWater close plus September Superion 256 launch create a new vertical-integration signal: first SkyWater-fabricated QPUs and prototype ion trapping are claimed, with customer deliveries targeted for 2027. This is a material roadmap acceleration signal, not proof of commercial economics.

Astera continues broadening from PCIe/CXL retimers into scale-up/scale-out fabric products; Q2 2026 revenue reached $392.4M and management expected Scorpio to become the largest product family in Q3, while Taurus 3.2T products target 200G-per-lane architectures.

Credo's active signal remains rapid AI-connectivity scaling plus optical expansion. The current machine observed a September 1 8-K and September 2 10-Q/S-8; prior company disclosure described a planned DustPhotonics acquisition and >$500M fiscal-2027 optical-revenue ambition. Concentration and integration require underwriting before canonical influence.
